sentences.text:
Prabin Kumar Dash vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 21 July,
2023
Author: Chittaranjan Dash
Bench: Chittaranjan Dash
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Ablapl No.6471 of 2023
 Prabin Kumar Dash .... Petitioner
 Ms. Sanjibani Mishra, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opp. Party

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. S. Patra, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s. 438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s.456/376/294/506/34 of IPC in connection with Buden PS Case No.67 of 2023 corresponding to GR Case No.609 of 2023 pending in the court of learned SDJM, Padampur.

3. Learned counsel for the parties, in course of hearing made allegation and counter allegation against each other and submitted to take lenient view in respect to both the parties against their respective cases.

4. Having regard to the nature of allegation and the offence alleged against the Petitioners and the aforesaid submissions, while this Court is not inclined to pass any order, in the event he // 2 //
surrenders in the court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case within three weeks, the court shall pass appropriate order in accordance with law keeping in view the gravity of the offence, the injuries and severity of the punishment on its own merit independently applying its wisdom allowing or rejecting the application not being influenced by the direction passed herein for disposal of application in any manner.
The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
Prabin Kumar Dash vs State Of Odisha .... Opp.
